title: 💬 One Subscription for WhatsApp, Instagram, and Facebook!
body: 💬 One Subscription for WhatsApp, Instagram, and Facebook!
Meta launched its “Meta One” subscription in India — a single subscription that bundles the benefits of WhatsApp Plus, Instagram Plus, and Facebook Plus instead of three separate subscriptions.
The subscription offers story redesign, sound effects, and creative tools, with higher limits for using AI tools to generate images and video.
There is also a higher tier that gives bigger limits and backup storage of up to 4 terabytes.
Would you pay for one subscription covering three platforms? Or do you prefer the free option?
